attributes.description: Overview of Claude Code OTel traces: request volume, token usage, latency, tool call activity, and errors.

embeddableConfig.content:
### Claude Code — Traces Overview
Real-time observability for Claude Code OTel traces (data stream: `traces-claude_code.otel-*`). Monitor LLM token usage & latency, request volume, tool call activity, and success rates — all in one place.

query.esql:
FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `LLM Request Count` = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `LLM Request Count` = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.tool.execution" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Tool Execution Count` = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.tool.execution" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Tool Execution Count` = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Unique Users` = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.user.email)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Unique Users` = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.user.email)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
  AND span.name IN ("claude_code.llm_request", "claude_code.tool.execution")
| STATS `Success rate percentage` = AVG(CASE(attributes.success == true, 100.0, attributes.success == false, 0.0, NULL))

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
  AND span.name IN ("claude_code.llm_request", "claude_code.tool.execution")
| STATS `Success rate percentage` = AVG(CASE(attributes.success == true, 100.0, attributes.success == false, 0.0, NULL))

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `count of spans` = COUNT(), duration_ns = AVG(duration) BY `span.name`
| EVAL `average duration_ms` = duration_ns / 1000000.0
| KEEP `span.name`, `count of spans`, `average duration_ms`
| SORT `count of spans` DESC
| LIMIT 100

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `count of spans` = COUNT(), duration_ns = AVG(duration) BY `span.name`
| EVAL `average duration_ms` = duration_ns / 1000000.0
| KEEP `span.name`, `count of spans`, `average duration_ms`
| SORT `count of spans` DESC
| LIMIT 100

query.esql:
FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS input = SUM(attributes.input_tokens),
        cache_read = SUM(attributes.cache_read_tokens),
        cache_creation = SUM(attributes.cache_creation_tokens),
        output = SUM(attributes.output_tokens)
| EVAL `Total tokens` = input + cache_read + cache_creation + output
| KEEP `Total tokens`

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS input = SUM(attributes.input_tokens),
        cache_read = SUM(attributes.cache_read_tokens),
        cache_creation = SUM(attributes.cache_creation_tokens),
        output = SUM(attributes.output_tokens)
| EVAL `Total tokens` = input + cache_read + cache_creation + output
| KEEP `Total tokens`

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Average LLM Request Duration` = ROUND(AVG(attributes.duration_ms))

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Average LLM Request Duration` = ROUND(AVG(attributes.duration_ms))

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Span Count` = COUNT() BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Span Count` = COUNT() BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS input = SUM(attributes.input_tokens),
        cache_read = SUM(attributes.cache_read_tokens),
        cache_creation = SUM(attributes.cache_creation_tokens),
        `Output tokens` = SUM(attributes.output_tokens)
    BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Input tokens` = input + cache_read + cache_creation
| KEEP bucket, `Input tokens`, `Output tokens`

FROM traces-claude_code.otel-*
| WHERE span.name == "claude_code.llm_request" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS input = SUM(attributes.input_tokens),
        cache_read = SUM(attributes.cache_read_tokens),
        cache_creation = SUM(attributes.cache_creation_tokens),
        `Output tokens` = SUM(attributes.output_tokens)
    BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Input tokens` = input + cache_read + cache_creation
| KEEP bucket, `Input tokens`, `Output tokens`
